text:
zoe-docs: opened a small PR to align the retention and deletion docs with the new audit-event schema + v2 SDK examples. Also found a broken link to the node SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4470

marc-sec: thanks — high level: avoid promising immediate deletion from backups. can you soften the language and add a legal-hold clause?

zoe-docs: current line is: 'We permanently delete customer data within 24 hours.' i'll switch to something like: 'We make commercially reasonable efforts to remove customer data from active systems and from backups in accordance with our retention policies; residual copies may persist for a limited period.'

rachael-legal: that wording looks good. add: 'Records may be retained if required by law or in response to a valid legal process.' also avoid specifying exact days in public docs unless product confirms an SLA.
